arxiv-1804-10985.title: Efficient Algorithms for Asymptotic Bounds on Termination Time in VASS
arxiv-1804-10985.creator: Tomáš Brázdil, Krishnendu Chatterjee, Antonín Kučera, Petr Novotný, Dominik Velan, Florian Zuleger
arxiv-1804-10985.description: Abstract . Vector Addition Systems with States (VASS) provide a well-known and fundamental model for the analysis of concurrent processes, parameterized systems, and are also used as abstract models of programs in resource bound analysis. In this paper we study the problem of obtaining asymptotic bounds on the termination time of a given VASS.

arxiv-2105-10799.creator: Gabriele Pisciotta, Miriana Somenzi, Elisa Barisani, Giulio Rossetti

arxiv-2111-04065.title: On the exactly-solvable semi-infinite quantum well of the non-rectangular step-harmonic profile
arxiv-2111-04065.creator: E.I. Jafarov, S.M. Nagiyev
arxiv-2111-04065.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by E.I. Jafarov, S.M. Nagiyev. An exactly-solvable model of the non-relativistic harmonic oscillator with a position-dependent effective mass is constructed. The model behaves itself as a semi-infinite quantum well of the non-rectangular profile. Such a form of the profile looks like a step-harmonic potential as a consequence of the certain analytical dependence of the effective mass from the position and semiconfinement parameter a a . Both states of the discrete and continuous spectrum are studied.

arxiv-2206-15460.title: Bayesian Causal Inference: A Critical Review
arxiv-2206-15460.creator: Fan Li 1, Peng Ding 2, and Fabrizia Mealli 3
arxiv-2206-15460.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Fan Li 1, Peng Ding 2, and Fabrizia Mealli 3. This paper provides a critical review of the Bayesian perspective of causal inference based on the potential outcomes framework. We review the causal estimands, assignment mechanism, the general structure of Bayesian inference of causal effects, and sensitivity analysis. We highlight issues that are unique to Bayesian causal inference, including the role of the propensity score, the definition of identifiability, the choice of priors in both low and high dimensional regimes.

arxiv-2302-04768.title: SpectraPy: a Python library for spectroscopic data reduction.
arxiv-2302-04768.creator: Marco Fumana
arxiv-2302-04768.description: Abstract SpectraPy is an Astropy affiliated package for spectroscopic data reduction. It collects algorithms and methods for data reduction of astronomical spectra obtained by through-slits spectrographs. It has been created to fill the gap in Astropy between the already existing data handling libraries and those for spectra analysis.

arxiv-2311-07985.title: Configurable convolutional neural networks for real-time pedestrian-level wind prediction in urban environments Publication type: Industrial Application Journal: Journal Volume: 00
arxiv-2311-07985.creator: Alfredo Vicente Clemente, Knut Erik Teigen Giljarhus, Luca Oggiano, Massimiliano Ruocco
arxiv-2311-07985.description: Abstract Urbanization has underscored the importance of understanding the pedestrian wind environment in urban and architectural design contexts. Pedestrian Wind Comfort (PWC) focuses on the effects of wind on the safety and comfort of pedestrians and cyclists, given the influence of urban structures on the local microclimate.

arxiv-2401-14934.title: Shadow Simulation of Quantum Processes
arxiv-2401-14934.creator: Xuanqiang Zhao, Xin Wang, Giulio Chiribella
arxiv-2401-14934.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xuanqiang Zhao, Xin Wang, Giulio Chiribella. We introduce the task of shadow process simulation, where the goal is to simulate the estimation of the expectation values of arbitrary quantum observables at the output of a target physical process. When the sender and receiver share random bits or other no-signaling resources, we show that the performance of shadow process simulation exceeds that of conventional process simulation protocols in a variety of scenarios including communication, noise simulation, and data compression.

arxiv-2409-03707.title: A Different Level Text Protection Mechanism With Differential Privacy
arxiv-2409-03707.creator: Qingwen Fu
arxiv-2409-03707.description: Abstract 1 Abstract With the widespread application of differential privacy in text protection, however, the current text cleaning mechanism based on metric local differential privacy (MLDP) is not applicable to non-metric semantic similarity measurement, and cannot achieve a good trade-off between privacy and practicality.

arxiv-2410-09501.title: Fine-grained subjective visual quality assessment for high-fidelity compressed images
arxiv-2410-09501.creator: Michela Testolina ∗,1, Mohsen Jenadeleh †,1, Shima Mohammadi ⋆, Shaolin Su †, João Ascenso ⋆, Touradj Ebrahimi ∗, Jon Sneyers ⋄, and Dietmar Saupe † ∗ Multimedia Signal Processing Group, EPFL, Lausanne, Switzerland {michela.testolina,touradj.ebrahimi}@epfl.ch † Multimedia Signal Processing Group, Un
arxiv-2410-09501.description: Abstract Advances in image compression, storage, and display technologies have made high-quality images and videos widely accessible. At this level of quality, distinguishing between compressed and original content becomes difficult, highlighting the need for assessment methodologies that are sensitive to even the smallest visual quality differences.

arxiv-2411-17129.title: Minimum-Distortion Continuous Cartograms by Numerically Optimized Meshes
arxiv-2411-17129.creator: Robert C. Sargent
arxiv-2411-17129.description: Abstract We present an algorithm for creating contiguous cartograms using meshes. We use numerical optimization to minimize cartographic error and distortion by transforming the mesh vertices. The vertices can either be optimized in the plane or optimized on the unit sphere and subsequently projected to the plane.

arxiv-2505-24107.title: GPTFootprint : Increasing Consumer Awareness of the Environmental Impacts of LLMs
arxiv-2505-24107.creator: Nora Graves, Vitus Larrieu, Y. Trace Zhang, Joanne Peng, Varun Nagaraj Rao, Yuhan Liu, Andrés Monroy-Hernández
arxiv-2505-24107.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nora Graves, Vitus Larrieu, Y. Trace Zhang, Joanne Peng, Varun Nagaraj Rao, Yuhan Liu, Andrés Monroy-Hernández. With the growth of AI, researchers are studying how to mitigate its environmental impact, primarily by proposing policy changes and increasing awareness among developers. However, research on AI end users is limited. Therefore, we introduce GPTFootprint , a browser extension that aims to increase consumer awareness of the significant water and energy consumption of LLMs, and reduce unnecessary LLM usage.

arxiv-2510-17590.title: MIRAGE: Agentic Framework for Multimodal Misinformation Detection with Web-Grounded Reasoning
arxiv-2510-17590.creator: Mir Nafis Sharear Shopnil, Sharad Duwal, Abhishek Tyagi, Adiba Mahbub Proma
arxiv-2510-17590.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mir Nafis Sharear Shopnil, Sharad Duwal, Abhishek Tyagi, Adiba Mahbub Proma. Misinformation spreads across web platforms through billions of daily multimodal posts that combine text and images, overwhelming manual fact-checking capacity. Supervised detection models require domain-specific training data and fail to generalize across diverse manipulation tactics.

arxiv-2512-13682.title: XID+PRIMA, II: Stepping through Hyperspectral Imaging to deblend PRIMAger Beyond the Extragalactic Confusion Limit
arxiv-2512-13682.creator: J. M. S. Donnellan, 1 B. Pautasso, 1 S. J. Oliver, 1 M. Béthermin, 2 L. Bing, 1 A. Bolatto, 3 L. Ciesla, 4 D. Koopmans, 5,6 A. Pope, 7 S. Serjeant, 8 L. Wang 5,6
arxiv-2512-13682.description: Abstract The PRobe far-Infrared Mission for Astrophysics (PRIMA) concept aims to map large areas with spectral coverage and sensitivities inaccessible to previous FIR space telescopes, covering 25–235 µm. We synthesise images representing a deep imaging survey, with realistic instrumental and confusion noise, reflecting the latest PRIMAger instrument specifications.

pmc-10573117.title: Translucency of Lithium-Based Silicate Glass–Ceramics Blocks for CAD/CAM Procedures: A Narrative Review
pmc-10573117.creator: Alessandro Vichi, Zejiao Zhao, Mahdi Mutahar, Gaetano Paolone, Chris Louca, Dilshat Tulyaganov
pmc-10573117.description: Amid chairside CAD/CAM materials, the use of lithium-based silicate glass–ceramics (LSGC) has been steadily increasing. This review aims to report on the translucency of these materials and the variables used to measure it. An electronic search was performed within the PubMed database within the period between 2 June 2011 and 11 September 2022.

pmc-10616733.creator: Kei Yamasaki, Saki Shigemi, Yosuke Chiba, Takako Kawaguchi, Hiroki Dosaka, Yutaka Ishiguro, Kazuhiro Yatera

pmc-11517055.title: Risks of high temperature exposure on infectious diseases in Portuguese hospitals
pmc-11517055.creator: M Oliveira, A M Alho, A P Oliveira, P Nogueira
pmc-11517055.description: BackgroundThe convergence of climate change and infectious diseases presents a growing public health challenge. As global temperatures continue to climb, the geographical spread of climate-sensitive diseases is shifting, underscoring the necessity for comprehensive early warning systems grounded in a One Health framework.

pmc-11648560.title: Low latency carbon budget analysis reveals a large decline of the land carbon sink in 2023
pmc-11648560.creator: Piyu Ke, Philippe Ciais, Stephen Sitch, Wei Li, Ana Bastos, Zhu Liu, Yidi Xu, Xiaofan Gui, Jiang Bian, Daniel S Goll, Yi Xi, Wanjing Li, Michael O'Sullivan, Jefferson Goncalves De Souza, Pierre Friedlingstein, Frédéric Chevallier
pmc-11648560.description: In 2023, the CO2 growth rate was 3.37 ± 0.11 ppm at Mauna Loa, which was 86% above that of the previous year and hit a record high since observations began in 1958, while global fossil fuel CO2 emissions only increased by 0.6% ± 0.5%.

pmc-11675003.title: Potential Probes for Targeted Intraoperative Fluorescence Imaging in Gastric Cancer
pmc-11675003.creator: Serena Martinelli, Laura Fortuna, Francesco Coratti, Federico Passagnoli, Amedeo Amedei, Fabio Cianchi
pmc-11675003.description: Simple SummaryGastric cancer (GC), a severe form of gastrointestinal malignancy, impacts around 1 million individuals each year and is associated with high mortality rates. Surgery, mainly radical gastrectomy, is the primary treatment, but challenges remain in distinguishing malignant from healthy tissue and identifying metastatic lymph nodes. Surgeons often remove all lymph nodes, increasing risks and recovery times.

pmc-12468488.title: Risk Factors for Transition of Care in Disorders of Gut–Brain Interaction: A Narrative Review and Expert Opinion
pmc-12468488.creator: Miguel Saps, Samantha Arrizabalo, Jose M Garza, Paul A Rufo
pmc-12468488.description: Background: Disorders of gut–brain interaction (DGBI) have a significant impact on the quality of life of children and families. Forty percent of children with recurrent abdominal pain continue to have symptoms into adulthood. Specialized programs for the transition of adolescents with DGBI to adult care are scarce. There are no widely accepted guidelines for transition of care.

pmc-12985529.title: Readiness and Implementation of Evidence-Based Practice Among Physiotherapists: A Cross-Sectional Study and Evidence-Based Practice Questionnaire Validation
pmc-12985529.creator: Christi Ojaste, Jarek Mäestu, Kadri Medijainen
pmc-12985529.description: Background/Objectives: Evidence-based practice (EBP) is a core competence in physiotherapy, yet its implementation in routine clinical practice remains inconsistent. This study aimed to describe self-reported EBP competencies among physiotherapists and to examine factors associated with daily EBP and readiness to implement EBP. Methods: A cross-sectional analytic survey was conducted among 337 practicing Estonian physiotherapists (75% female) between 2022 and 2024.

pmc-13383933.title: Surgical Treatment of Injury to the Posteromedial Meniscocapsular‐Extra‐articular Attachment Associated With Rupture of the Anterior Cruciate Ligament
pmc-13383933.creator: Jonas Eck, Tayfun Yilmaz, Hagen Schmal, Kaywan Izadpanah
pmc-13383933.description: Concomitant injuries are often present in the knee affected by anterior cruciate ligament injuries. Certain injuries are routinely identified, whereas others may be inadvertently neglected. Such injuries include lesions to the posteromedial meniscocapsular‐extra‐articular attachments. This can result in instability not only of the medial meniscus but also of the knee joint as a whole.

pmc-13632116.title: Associations of traumatic brain injury with incident cardiovascular disease: Results from the atherosclerosis risk in communities (ARIC) study
pmc-13632116.creator: Katherine J Hunzinger, Bernadette A D’Alonzo, Anthony Thompson, Connor A Law, Michael T Nguyen, Sandro Marini, Saef Izzy, Holly Elser, Alvaro Alonso, Michelle Johansen, Andrea LC Schneider
pmc-13632116.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). beyond the central nervous system [1]. Prior population-level studies, which have largely relied solely on administrative claims or tertiary-center datasets, have shown associations with TBI and cardiovascular (CV) outcomes [2,3]. Accordingly, there is a pressing need for large, prospective, community-based studies with broader representation, time-varying TBI modeling, long duration of follow-up time, and multi-sourced and adjudicated outcome ascertainment to more precisely define the long-term CV consequences of TBI and to determine whether cumulative or more severe injuries confer disproportionate CV risk.
